activate.title: Activate NextHubX
activate.subtitle: Enter your personal email and activation code to activate
activate.resetNotice: This device has been reset or your seat is no longer valid. Please reactivate with your activation code.
activate.resetNoticeWithEmail: Account {{email}} has been reset or is no longer valid. Please reactivate with this account's email and activation code; contact your administrator for a new code.

verify.verifying: Verifying exit IP… (usually completes within ~15 seconds after TUN switches)
verify.mismatchHint: Exit IP check in progress: the detected exit has not switched to your assigned exit yet, which is normal during the transition. Your account will appear automatically once verified; if it takes longer than a minute, check your connection or contact support.

feedback.empty: Please enter your personal email and activation code
feedback.invalid: Email or activation code is incorrect, or the code has already been used/expired. Double-check your personal email and the activation code, then retry. If you activated on another device, contact your administrator to reset it.
feedback.networkError: Network error, please try again later
feedback.unknown: Activation failed, please try again later

service.guideBody: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to create a global proxy adapter. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is only required once.

fallback.title: Fell back to system proxy mode
fallback.body: The network service is not installed or permission was denied, so system proxy mode is used. Traffic from apps that ignore proxy settings may bypass the proxy.

gate.title: TUN network service required
gate.body: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to create the TUN virtual adapter and take over global traffic. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is required only once; the app cannot be used until it is installed.
gate.supportBody: The network service could not be installed after several attempts. Please contact technical support for help and provide your system information.

account.title: Account
account.empty: No account information yet, please activate first

usage.title: How to use this account
usage.body: Use the Google account above (email + password) to sign in to the third-party service (claude.ai) via the 'Continue with Google' button. Note: this sign-in account is different from the personal email you used to activate — the personal email is only for activating this app. Do not change the password, bind a personal phone number, or enable two-factor authentication, and do not use it for personal purposes. This account is for your work use only; contact your administrator if you run into sign-in issues.

bind.pendingBody: Activated. Please ask your supervisor (team admin) to send you a Claude Team binding invite; the next step will appear here automatically once it's sent.
bind.invitedBody: Binding invite sent. Check your personal inbox (including spam) for the Claude team invite link → open it → sign in with the account + password below and accept the invite → come back and tap "Confirm joined".
bind.notInvited: The invite hasn't been sent yet — try again later or contact your administrator.
bind.confirmFail: Failed to confirm, please try again later.
bind.boundLabel: Joined Claude Team. Sign in to claude.ai with the account below (Continue with Google).
bind.creatorBody: Your team owner (manager) account is being set up by our operations team — including creating the Claude team and the subscription. Once it's ready, the account and password will appear here. No action needed; tap refresh to check progress.
bind.creatorBoundLabel: Team created. Sign in to claude.ai with the account below (Continue with Google) to manage your team.

totp.title: 2FA code
totp.hint: If sign-in asks to verify a phone number: tap "Try another way", choose "Get a verification code from the authenticator app", then enter this 6-digit code.

sync.revokedNotice: This device has been reset or your seat is no longer valid. Please reactivate with your activation code.

exitGuard.title: Exit IP mismatch
exitGuard.body: The current exit IP ({{actual}}) does not match your assigned exit ({{expected}}). Your traffic may be leaving through the wrong exit. Please check your connection or contact technical support.
exitGuard.notifyBody: Current exit ({{actual}}) differs from your assigned exit ({{expected}}). Please open NextHubX and check your connection.

clashVergeConflict.title: Clash Verge conflict detected
clashVergeConflict.runningBody: Clash Verge is running and will compete with NextHubX for the same network service, causing your connections to keep dropping. Please fully close it by following these steps:
clashVergeConflict.appearedBody: Clash Verge has just started and will disconnect your connection. Please fully close it by following these steps:
clashVergeConflict.blockingActivate: Clash Verge is running and competes with NextHubX for the same network service (TUN / system proxy). It must be fully closed before you can activate.
clashVergeConflict.forceStopHint: Click "Force-stop Clash Verge" on the right to kill its leftover processes (including the background core) and disable its launch-at-login. Because its core runs with admin privileges, macOS will prompt for your password once — just enter it (no password needed if it's no longer running and only launch-at-login must be turned off). It re-checks automatically afterward. You can re-enable Clash Verge's launch-at-login later in its settings.
clashVergeConflict.forceStopOk: Clash Verge stopped and its launch-at-login disabled — you can activate now
clashVergeConflict.forceStopCancelled: Cancelled (password not entered; Clash Verge is still running)
clashVergeConflict.forceStopStillRunning: Tried to stop, but the Clash Verge core is still running (likely restarted by its service). Please quit Clash Verge or stop its service manually, then retry.
clashVergeConflict.forceStopFailed: Failed to stop Clash Verge. Please quit it manually and retry.
